inspection_method: Generated output and byte-identical workspace PNG opened using view_image; visual comparison to opened design reference. Manual landmark circle geometry supplements visual review; not a segmentation or runtime UI test.

identity.observed: Same frontal mature brown-bearded warrior; segmented round iron helmet with gold ridge/brow/nose guard, paired side braids and central beard plait, brown fur mantle, gold ring torc, iron mail and diagonal leather strap. No invented horns/crown. Fine engraving varies and is not a pixel-exact copy.

square_crop.observed: 1254 square, centered face, complete helmet/head/beard visible. Shoulders intentionally leave the lower side edges; no head or headgear clipping.

circular_crop.observed: Whole helmet/head/beard fits a centered circle, including a 95%-diameter disc. Lower shoulder corners would be trimmed as expected. Do not reuse existing MVP hero crop settings blindly.
circular_crop.precision: landmarks are approximate visual estimates, not a full pixel mask

palette.observed: Muted iron grey on helmet/mail, warm brown fur/beard/leather, controlled antique gold on helmet and torc, warm skin, charcoal backdrop. Values are shaded paint interpretations, not exact flat hex swatches.

craft.observed: Visible broad painted facial planes, tactile sculpted fur/beard, matte leather and restrained metallic highlights. Mail is fairly detailed; needs thumbnail-scale assessment in eventual UI.

constraints.observed: One character, no text/frame/watermark/UI, charcoal opaque background, no weapons/hands/pedestal.

prompt_deviations.observed: Helmet crest is approximately 4.8% below the top, rather than requested 14%; head/helmet therefore reads larger than the suggested layout. Whole identity remains visible with circle margin. Preserve full canvas; do not zoom tighter without crop review.
Painted engraving/panel details are reinterpreted at bust resolution; the design anchors and material families remain recognizable.

correction_decision: No visibly broken anatomy, clipped headgear, wrong identity, text or palette defect requiring the one allowed correction. Framing variation documented; no second generation.
not_verified: 32/40 px icon readability in actual ROOM/LOBBY/PANEL/GAMEOVER screens
